headline: Ten days of chamber music on the southern shore
summary: Two kitchen parties, a candlelit night in the cemetery chapel, and a finale at Université Sainte-Anne. Every event small by design.
intro: Placeholder. For its second season the festival returns to Yarmouth with a slightly larger company of musicians, two kitchen parties, a lunchtime concert, an evening in the cemetery chapel and a finale at Université Sainte-Anne.
Placeholder. Every event is small by design. Come early, sit close, and stay to meet the musicians afterward.
afterword: Placeholder. Thank you to everyone who came, cooked, drove, billeted and listened. Photographs from the festival are below, and dates for 2027 will be announced in the spring.
scheduleNote: Seating is limited at every event. Doors open thirty minutes before each concert.

events.title: Classical Kitchen Party I
description: The festival opens the way it began: in a kitchen, with music, food and good company. Refreshments included.

program.work: String Quartet in D major, Op. 76 No. 5

events.title: Open Rehearsal
description: Drop in and listen as the musicians work through the week's music. Come and go as you please.

events.title: Classical Kitchen Party II
description: An afternoon house concert of music for clarinet and strings.

program.work: Clarinet Quintet in A major, K. 581

events.title: Lunchtime Concert
description: An hour of music in the middle of the day. Bring your lunch.

program.work: Clarinet Trio in A minor, Op. 114

events.title: Night Music in the Dark
description: The candlelit evening returns. Spacious, quiet music in near-darkness. Dress warmly.

program.note: from *Quatuor pour la fin du temps*

events.title: Finale
description: The whole company comes together to close the season. A reception with the artists follows.
